entities.summary: Marit Arnstad is a Norwegian lawyer and politician for the Centre Party. She served as the party's parliamentary leader from 2014 to 2025, having previously held the office from 2003 to 2005. Arnstad was the Norwegian Minister of Transport from 2012 to 2013 and Minister of Petroleum and Energy from 1997 to 2000.
